card.title: IPad 7 No Touch

claims.statement: iPad 7 no touch: test a new digitizer, inspect both touch connectors, diode-check against reference values and check filters and shorts near the touch IC.
A low (near 0) diode reading on SPI_GRAPE_SCLK means a CPU-to-board disconnection needing a CPU reball.

procedure: Inspect and diode-check both touch connectors.
Check filters; find shorts with voltage injection.
Check SPI_GRAPE_SCLK; reball CPU if low.
Reball or replace touch IC last.
card.caveats: Expected SPI_GRAPE_SCLK value is in an image. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
